items.title: Interview with Telemundo, channel 47 about AI and its dangers.
items.blurb: Telemundo 47's Enfoque asked me to explain AI to a general audience: where it came from, why people fear it, and how it should be controlled, starting with government regulation.

items.title: Talk: "If your client has the same AI subscription, why do they need you?"
items.blurb: On October 7 I shared real AI use cases already in production at Tombras: synthetic audiences, campaign briefs in minutes, campaigns where AI is the idea, and what all of this means for the role of the engineer.
